_readme: RASAero II's own flight results for this design, typed in from its Flight window (Simulations -> Flight).
The JARVIS predictions page shows them next to Jarvis and OpenRocket for the launch condition named in 'sim'
(a simulation saved in the .ork). Use null for 'sim' when the .ork has no matching condition; the page lists it
in a note instead. Units are as RASAero shows them: feet, feet per second, seconds, degrees from vertical, mph.
Update these numbers whenever RASAero is run again on a changed design.
